description: An empty list, none, or {} passed to a local function takes the type the same parameter has at the function's other calls, and the program runs as if a typed value had been passed.
program: (let [total (fn [booked] (reduce (fn [sum m] (+ sum (get m :size))) 0 booked)) report (fn [label booked] {:label label :total (total booked)}) size-of (fn [item] (match item (some i) (get i :size) none 0)) sizes (fn [by-id] (map (fn [group] (get (first group) :size)) (vals by-id))) kept [{:id "a" :size 3} {:id "b" :size 4}]] {:reports [(report "first" []) (report "second" kept)] :sizes [(size-of none) (size-of (some {:id "a" :size 5}))] :grouped [(sizes {}) (sizes (into-map (group-by (fn [i] (get i :id)) kept)))]})
